hero.description: BudStock is a platform where extra materials find new owners. Save time and money by buying cheaper, or free up your space.

1.title: Take a photo
1.desc: Photograph the leftover materials in good lighting.

2.title: Add description
2.desc: Specify characteristics, quantity, and a fair price.

3.title: Set location
3.desc: Buyers will find you on the map right in their neighborhood.
